newsitem.title: USA: Nortek agrees to acquire Ply Gem.
newsitem.headline: Nortek agrees to acquire Ply Gem.

text.p: Nortek Inc said it agreed to acquire Ply Gem Industries Inc for $19.50 per share, topping Atrium Corp's $18.75 bid for the maker of home improvement products, including replacement windows and siding.
Nortek would pay about $310 million to purchase Ply Gem common stock and settle common stock options and would assume or refinance about $172 million of Ply Gem's debt, Nortek said in a news release.
The deal, approved by Ply Gem's board, would be effected first by a tender offer, followed by a merger to acquire the balance of Ply Gem shares not tendered in the first step.
Ply Gem terminated its previous $18.75 per share merger pact with Atrium Acquisition Holdings Corp, an affiliate of buyout firm Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc that was first announced one month ago.

As a result, Nortek said Atrium will be paid $9.5 million in breakup fees and is entitled to up to $2.5 million for expense reimbursement. Nortek has provided funds for these payments by purchasing today 640,000 shares of Ply Gem common stock at $18.75 per share.
A spokesman for Hicks Muse said Atrium does not intend to pursue the transaction.
"Ply Gem is a good company. At 18-3/4 we felt it was a good investment, but another party has come foward that is willing to pay more for Ply Gem than we are.
"We will continue to execute our buy-and-build strategy for Atrium by other means," the Hicks Muse spokesman told Reuters.
Nortek makes and distributes residential and commercial building and remodeling products, particularly residential ventilation products and indoor air quality systems.

In 1996, the Providence, R.I. company earned $22 million, or $2.07 per share primary, on sales of $970 million, versus 1995 earnings of $15 million, or $1.19 per share primary, on sales of $776.2 million.

New York-based Ply Gem makes and distributes building and home improvement products used primarily in residential remodeling and construction. Products include vinyl and wood windows and doors, vinyl siding and accessories, skylights, specialty wood products and other home decor and improvement products.

Ply Gem's results for the year ended December 31, 1996 were net income of $10.5 million, or $0.74 per share, on sales of $775 million versus 1995's loss of $7.4 million after a $7.6 million after-tax charge, or a net loss of $0.51 per share, on sales of $755.2 million.
